findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "gestoria_send_message" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kuotia_get_autonomo_guide, gestoria_send_message · Private data: kuotia_get_tax_calendar, kuotia_get_autonomo_guide, gestoria_get_tax_status, gestoria_get_obligations, gestoria_send_message · Public sink: gestoria_send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kuotia_get_autonomo_guide, gestoria_send_message · Private data: kuotia_get_tax_calendar, kuotia_get_autonomo_guide, gestoria_get_tax_status, gestoria_get_obligations, gestoria_send_message · Public sink: gestoria_send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
